create_sailvos3d_dataset: create a SAILVOS3DWAI dataset instance with a specified split, root directory, and resolution
run_sailvos3d_cli: run the SAILVOS3D dataset CLI to load and iterate through views with optional Rerun visualization
sample_views_from_scene: sample N covisible views from a SAILVOS3D scene using pairwise covisibility maps
load_sailvos3d_scene_metadata: load precomputed SAILVOS3D scene list metadata from numpy files for a given split
visualize_sailvos3d_views: visualize SAILVOS3D dataset views with RGB images, depth maps, and 3D point clouds using Rerun
